subject: english
prompt: Which habit best helps a learner understand a new English article?

options.text: Skip every unknown word and the title.
Copy the first sentence as the whole meaning.
Use context, check key words, and confirm the main idea.
Choose an answer only because it is longest.

answer.explanation: Context, key words, and main-idea checking support reliable reading.
